classification.difficultyReason: Combine different changes to weekly pay and working hours, then compare the resulting hourly rates.

content.prompt: A man earns a salary of $\$2440$ for working a 44-hour week. His weekly salary is increased by $12.5\%$ and his hours are reduced by $10\%$. Find the percentage increase in his new hourly salary.

answer.worked:
Hourly salary is weekly salary divided by weekly hours. Keep the hourly rates exact until comparing them.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Original hourly salary}&=\frac{2440}{44}\\\text{New weekly salary}&=2440\times1.125=2745\\\text{New weekly hours}&=44\times0.90=39.6\\\text{New hourly salary}&=\frac{2745}{39.6}\\\text{New hourly salary as a percentage of original}&=\frac{2745/39.6}{2440/44}\times100\%\\\text{New hourly salary as a percentage of original}&=125\%\\\text{Percentage increase}&=125\%-100\%=25\%.\end{align*}$$
